name: Nitroglycerin
summary: At Bael Modan, Nitroglycerin lets dwarves press their excavation into tauren lands. Soldiers and officers carry the volatile chemical, which can also be turned against the fortress.

sections.title: Industrial Demolition
sections.body: At Bael Modan, dwarves dig into the ancestral lands of the Stonespire tauren. Heavy drillers and volatile chemicals help them drive the excavation forward. At the site and its fortified keep, they use nitroglycerin to blast deep holes and break apart hills. Soldiers and officers carry vials as the work continues, among them Lord Cyrik Blackforge.

sections.title: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
sections.body: After Prospector Khazgorm dies, Gann Stonespire seeks to destroy the fortress encroaching on his people's lands. The displaced tauren studies dwarven engineering plans despite the danger. He learns that nitroglycerin, wood pulp, and sodium nitrate can be combined into a charge strong enough to strike Bael Modan's military garrison.

faq.answer: Dwarven forces at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens carry nitroglycerin. Among them are Bael'dun Soldiers, Riflemen, Officers, and Lord Cyrik Blackforge in the keep.

faq.q: What is the nitroglycerin used for?
faq.answer: Gann Stonespire combines nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate to make a powerful charge against Bael Modan's military fortress.

faq.q: Why were the dwarves carrying it in the first place?
faq.answer: At their archaeological dig site, Bael Modan prospectors and soldiers use explosives, steam engines, and volatile chemicals to open the earth.
Gann Stonespire is an exiled tauren warrior. The dwarves built the Bael Modan excavation site and keep on his tribe's ancestral lands, driving the Stonespire from them through industrial destruction.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know nitroglycerin as a compounding explosive. Wood pulp absorbs it, while sodium nitrate helps make it stable and detonable.
As a tauren, you know the volatile chemicals around Bael Modan as a bitter mark of the destruction inflicted on the Stonespire tribe.
